settings.title: Home Widget Boards
settings.description: Choose which boards' posts appear in the home page recent and popular posts widgets.
settings.notice: This only controls visibility and does not change read permissions. The notice ticker is not affected.
settings.help: Drag a card between the two areas, or use the X / + button on the card. New boards are included automatically.
settings.included_hint: Boards whose posts appear in the widgets
settings.excluded_hint: Boards whose posts are hidden from the widgets
settings.empty_excluded: Drop a card here to hide that board from the widgets.

home.title: Home Page Settings
home.description: Turn the five home sections on or off, choose one or two columns and pick the widget for each column.

guide.layout: Where sections 1 to 5 sit on the home page: they stack from the top in order 1, 2 … 5, above the old home widgets. Turn each section on or off and choose 1 or 2 columns here.
guide.s1: Section 1 is the first of the new sections at the top of the home page. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.
guide.s2: Section 2 sits right below section 1. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.
guide.s3: Section 3 sits right below section 2. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.
guide.s4: Section 4 sits right below section 3. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.
guide.s5: Section 5 is the last new section, right above the old home widgets. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.

layout.excluded_help: Boards excluded here are not shown in recent or popular columns (the news ticker is not affected). This only controls visibility, not read permission.

col.col1: Left column (the only one with 1 column)
col.board_pick_help: Drag cards between the two areas or use the X / + buttons. Only boards in 'Not included' are left out; new boards are included automatically. This only controls visibility, not read permission.
col.section_off: This section is off. Turn it on in the Widget Layout tab.
col.limit_popular_hint: Popular posts are picked from the site-wide popular cache, so fewer items than set may appear.
col.title: Title
col.html_help: HTML only. Scripts, event attributes (onclick, ...) and javascript: links are removed both when saving and when showing.
